race.comment: IN CIRCLES (4) is the horse to beat after breaking through at this track and distance as a well-supported favourite, and we'll get a guide on that form in the race prior through On The Fly. Should find the front again here from a better draw and she'll take plenty of catching if she runs up to her latest effort. ALABAMA HUSSY (10) looks the main danger despite not quite finishing off when fourth at Goulburn. Keatings hops on board now, hopping off IN CIRCLES and she maps to get every chance. Can get back to winning ways. THE HARD ROAD (2) tired late in CL1 grade at Canberra but was only beaten a length and a half, and his prior win at this track keeps him firmly in the mix. OLE MISS (5) comes off a well-supported BM50 win at Goulburn and has the right recent form. Can feature on the back of that effort.
